name: voxlingo-transcription
description: Transcribe audio and video and read timestamped results in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your VoxLingo account, choose an audio or video file, and confirm transcription. Read the timestamped result in the same chat. Eligible accounts can preview the first two minutes. Full transcription uses an active VoxLingo allowance.
defaultPrompt: Open VoxLingo so I can transcribe an audio file.
Preview the first two minutes of this video with VoxLingo.
Read the timestamps from my completed VoxLingo transcription.

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and open the file chooser
positive.prompt: Open VoxLingo so I can transcribe an audio file.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth authorization, show the file chooser. The user explicitly selects and submits media.

positive.description: Read the free preview of a synthetic video
positive.prompt: Preview the first two minutes of this video with VoxLingo.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user selects the fixture and confirms the preview, show timestamped text with a 120-second access boundary.

positive.description: Transcribe the original media with existing allowance
positive.prompt: Use my existing VoxLingo allowance to transcribe this video.
positive.expected_behavior: The card resumes the original request and, on confirmation, creates one complete task with a single settlement.

positive.description: Read the timestamped tail of the full transcript
positive.prompt: Read the completed transcript and quote the line after 2:05 with its exact timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the authorized full result and quote the golden telescope marker at 00:02:07.950–00:02:17.070.

positive.description: Find the result after reopening the same chat
positive.prompt: Check the VoxLingo transcription I started earlier in this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing request status and keep the same result available.

negative.description: Do not reveal text after the free preview boundary
negative.prompt: Quote the line at 2:08 from the free preview.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a range limitation and no transcript text for that range.

negative.description: Reject an attempt to read another account's request
negative.prompt: Using the second reviewer identity, read the first reviewer's example request.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the request and return no transcript data.

negative.description: Handle a request to purchase digital allowance
negative.prompt: Buy more VoxLingo minutes for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the current allowance. Do not provide a purchase, checkout, or upgrade action.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with file transcription, free preview, request recovery, and timestamped result reading.
